protocol.change: Distinct quantize_int4_packed and quantize_int4_packed_out entry points for N<=16. Existing quantize signatures and default parsing unchanged. No automatic policy.
protocol.primary_metric: CUDA event time across CUDA Graph replay of quantize-only kernels; each 64-node graph uses the same input and reusable output buffers; both original and packed use identical block size
protocol.secondary_metric: Synchronized wall time per ordinary Python call at 256 threads for allocating and reusable-output APIs
protocol.acceptance: Each round and dtype/thread group device target geomean >=1.10 and no packed target or legacy control median slower by >5%. Host timing is reported separately; no host speedup requirement or auto routing inferred. Additionally require every host packed and legacy control median within 5% regression in every round; reject if any fails.
protocol.correctness: Independent CPU oracle and exact old/new output bytes; small-N tails, 2D/4D, extremes/subnormals/rounding ties, guarded output and version counters, streams and changing-input graph replay, invalid layouts rejected before mutation
protocol.revision_reason: Initial extra row_layout argument passed device gates but caused repeatable ~0.2us ordinary out-call overhead. Preserve the initial experiment; validate distinct entry points against the same original baseline.
